definition: A psychometric function is a model used in psychophysical assessment to describe an observer’s performance when estimating a threshold. An important feature of this function is its slope, or equivalently its spread, which reflects how steeply performance changes and can affect the accuracy and variability of threshold estimates.

reasons: The packet supports psychometric function as a model function with a slope/spread parameter, but it does not explicitly support the broader definitional claim that it is used in “psychophysical assessment” or that it specifically describes an observer’s performance when estimating a threshold.
